task: Isolate the Sentinel integrity probe regression test from ambient release-unit active-plan authority without weakening Sentinel integrity decisions.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: Live U01 child proof CI #9052 on exact child head 20d8b0f88eff5eeda209c61c2d9841a3ab9c7dfc reached trusted workflow_dispatch successfully, then failed one of 3424 tests: tests/shoperation-sentinel-integrity.test.ts expected the daily integrity probe to PASS but received BLOCK. The child CI globally sets SHOPERATION_ACTIVE_PLAN to artifacts/shoperation-development-guard/release-unit-active-plan.json. The test constructs synthetic normalized main evidence from repository quality/development/active-plan.json, but its spawnSync environment inherits SHOPERATION_ACTIVE_PLAN, so the probe evaluates the release-unit child plan instead. This mixes two development transaction authorities and causes SENTINEL_INTEGRITY_TRANSACTION_IDENTITY_DRIFT. Main CI passes because the ambient release-unit plan override is absent.
observableOutcomes: The daily-integrity regression test explicitly binds the probe to quality/development/active-plan.json regardless of ambient child CI environment variables.
The same test passes in ordinary main CI and release-unit child CI without changing Sentinel BLOCK semantics.
A true transaction identity mismatch still produces Sentinel BLOCK.
No production Sentinel authority, proof semantics, thresholds, guard registry or release-unit child plan is weakened or bypassed.
The unchanged U01 child proof proceeds beyond the current Sentinel integrity test failure.
unresolvedRisks: Clearing the wrong environment variable could hide a legitimate release-unit plan authority instead of isolating only the synthetic daily-probe test.
Changing Sentinel evaluation logic to ignore transaction drift would create a false PASS and is forbidden.
A test-only hard-code could become stale if the canonical repository active-plan path changes without corresponding test maintenance.
The repeated SQ-FP-6228AC79A5A40E53 fingerprint indicates this environment-coupling class was not previously classified at the earliest preventable phase.

in: Bind only the daily-integrity subprocess test to the repository active plan it uses to construct synthetic evidence.
Add regression coverage that an ambient release-unit SHOPERATION_ACTIVE_PLAN cannot alter this test's selected plan.
Preserve all Sentinel integrity findings, transaction identity checks and proof-semantic evaluation unchanged.
Replay the exact U01 child proof after merge.
out: No change to guard-registry proof semantics or Completion Truth requirements.
No change to release-unit child plan generation, executor state or release risk thresholds.
No suppression, skip, allowlist or expected-BLOCK rewrite for the failing test.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: This test validates Sentinel's ability to detect integrity drift while running inside the same CI that proves release-unit transactions. A false PASS would weaken assurance, while a false BLOCK deadlocks the canonical release path. The fix must isolate test authority without changing Sentinel semantics.

acceptanceCriteria: tests/shoperation-sentinel-integrity.test.ts explicitly supplies SHOPERATION_ACTIVE_PLAN=quality/development/active-plan.json to the subprocess that claims to test real registry/plan plus normalized main evidence.
A regression simulating an ambient child-plan override still evaluates the repository plan selected by the test.
Existing tests that intentionally pass transaction drift to evaluateSentinelIntegrity continue to BLOCK.
No production Sentinel implementation file changes.
Exact-head CI, Completion Truth and Lifecycle Closure pass before merge.
After merge, the immutable rehearsal is replayed and U01 child Quality Tests move past the Sentinel integrity test.
invariants: Sentinel transaction identity drift remains blocking.
The test's evidence producer and the probe's selected plan must refer to the same development transaction authority.
Ambient CI variables may not silently change the authority under test.
Release-unit child CI continues to use its generated release-unit active plan for real child gates outside this isolated test subprocess.
No PASS is manufactured by deleting evidence, changing thresholds or ignoring child plan context.

failureModes: The subprocess inherits release-unit active-plan authority and synthetic main evidence mismatches it.
The fix globally removes SHOPERATION_ACTIVE_PLAN and breaks real child gates.
The Sentinel evaluator is weakened instead of the test being isolated.
The test passes on main but fails again under workflow_dispatch child proof.
A future active-plan path change makes the test point to a noncanonical plan.
edgeCases: SHOPERATION_ACTIVE_PLAN is unset as on ordinary main CI.
SHOPERATION_ACTIVE_PLAN points to a release-unit child plan as on U01 CI.
SHOPERATION_ACTIVE_PLAN points to a nonexistent path.
Synthetic evidence base differs from the explicitly selected repository plan and must still BLOCK.
The probe is invoked outside the test and should continue honoring an explicit active-plan override.
A release-unit child plan has stronger or different completion requirements than the repository plan.
The child CI is rerun after main advances but the materialized child base remains exact.
The test process has unrelated Sentinel environment variables already set.

alternatives.summary: Explicitly set SHOPERATION_ACTIVE_PLAN to the repository active-plan path only in the daily-integrity test subprocess.
alternatives.reason: It aligns the probe authority with the evidence source while preserving production behavior and child CI authority.

alternatives.summary: Remove SHOPERATION_ACTIVE_PLAN from the entire child CI job.
alternatives.reason: Real release-unit gates require the generated child plan and would lose canonical authority.

alternatives.summary: Change Sentinel to ignore transaction mismatch when running under release-unit CI.
alternatives.reason: This would launder a real integrity violation and create false PASS.

alternatives.summary: Change the test expectation from PASS to BLOCK under child CI.
alternatives.reason: The test claims to validate coherent normalized main evidence; ambient authority leakage is the defect, not the expected result.

specialistReviews.finding: The issue appears only after real workflow_dispatch child proof because that path exports SHOPERATION_ACTIVE_PLAN to the CI environment.
specialistReviews.resolution: Keep the child plan for actual gates but override it only inside the synthetic daily-probe test subprocess.

specialistReviews.finding: SQ-FP-6228AC79A5A40E53 has recurred across prior intakes, so simply rerunning would repeat an unclassified failure.
specialistReviews.resolution: Treat this occurrence as a deterministic environment-authority coupling and add regression coverage before replay.

specialistReviews.finding: Plan authority is contextual; tests that spawn authority-sensitive tools must bind the intended context explicitly.
specialistReviews.resolution: Make authority selection explicit at the subprocess boundary.

specialistReviews.finding: The defect is a subprocess environment-boundary leak: the spawned Sentinel probe inherits SHOPERATION_ACTIVE_PLAN from child CI even though the test synthesizes evidence from the repository active plan.
specialistReviews.resolution: Bind SHOPERATION_ACTIVE_PLAN only on the test subprocess environment; keep production probe environment semantics unchanged.

challenge.scenario: Child CI exports a release-unit active plan while the test builds evidence from repository active-plan.json.
challenge.finding: Probe and evidence use different base authority, producing transaction drift.
challenge.resolution: Explicitly bind test subprocess to repository active plan.

challenge.finding: The explicit binding should behave identically to the current passing main path.
challenge.resolution: Use the same canonical repository path that the probe already defaults to.

challenge.scenario: A real child gate needs the release-unit plan after this fix.
challenge.finding: A job-wide unset would break child verification.
challenge.resolution: Scope the override to the single spawnSync env object in the test.

challenge.scenario: Someone proposes changing evaluateSentinelIntegrity to tolerate base mismatch.
challenge.finding: That would hide a genuine provenance defect.
challenge.resolution: No production evaluator changes; preserve BLOCK behavior.

challenge.scenario: Ambient SHOPERATION_ACTIVE_PLAN points to a malformed or missing child plan.
challenge.finding: The test must remain deterministic and independent of unrelated ambient plan selection.
challenge.resolution: Explicit repository-plan binding makes the test deterministic while production probe still fails closed on malformed explicit inputs.

challenge.scenario: The repository plan itself contains an actual proof-semantic defect.
challenge.finding: Explicit binding must not manufacture PASS if the repository plan is incoherent.
challenge.resolution: The Sentinel still evaluates the real repository plan and will BLOCK on actual findings.

challenge.scenario: Synthetic evidence is modified to disagree with the explicitly bound repository plan.
challenge.finding: Isolation must not disable transaction-drift detection.
challenge.resolution: Retain existing dedicated drift tests and add no evaluator exception.

challenge.scenario: The same test is executed under a future release-unit child CI with different generated plan content.
challenge.finding: Ambient differences must not affect the intended daily-main probe regression.
challenge.resolution: Explicit plan selection at the subprocess boundary remains stable across child plan variants.

requirements.requirement: The daily Sentinel integrity regression must evaluate the same repository plan authority used to construct its normalized evidence, independent of ambient release-unit CI plan overrides.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Sentinel transaction identity drift must remain blocking.
Real release-unit child gates may not lose their generated child active-plan authority.

notes: Plan-only transaction from live U01 child proof CI #9052. Exact failure fingerprint SQ-FP-6228AC79A5A40E53. Proven mechanism: the test reads quality/development/active-plan.json to create synthetic evidence, while spawnSync inherits SHOPERATION_ACTIVE_PLAN=artifacts/shoperation-development-guard/release-unit-active-plan.json from child CI; normalizeSentinelControlPlaneEvidence then compares child plan changeBaseSha with repository-plan-derived edit-time evidence and correctly emits transaction identity drift. Production Sentinel semantics remain authoritative and unchanged. Plan gate CI #9055 / run 37628258801 reconciled the projected test-only material scope to subsystem release-infrastructure with no domain/authority classifier assignments and rejected the noncanonical Sentinel specialist role. This revision adopts those canonical classifications without changing the intended test-isolation fix. Prerequisite Control Plane neutral critical ownership fix merged via PR #1045 at main 22c11e6a724d374295c7cd95d6333e8ba8352104; this fresh projection now truthfully declares empty domain/authority ownership for the neutral test-only material scope while preserving release-infrastructure intent classification. Plan gate CI #9063 / run 37633441458 confirmed neutral expectedAuthorities=[] is valid after PR #1045, while the critical semantic execution route still requires an explicit execution authority category; route.authority is therefore bound to release-infrastructure without inventing projected ownership.
